# Progress Indicator

Progress Indicator enables incremental navigation through a series of steps or stages in a process. It provides clear visual cues indicating the current step to help users understand their progress.

**Stylesheet:** `components/progress-indicator/progress-indicator.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## 

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active-step` | number | — | Index of the currently active step (1-based) |
| `alignment` | "horizontal" \| "vertical" | "horizontal" | Layout direction of the progress indicator |
| `show-step-name` | boolean | true | Whether to display the step title text |
| `show-step-description` | boolean | true | Whether to display the step description text |
| `RTL` | boolean | false | Right-to-left layout direction |

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | — | Step title text |
| `description` | string | — | Step description text |
| `status` | "completed" \| "current" \| "upcoming" | — | Visual state of the step (derived from active-step) |

## 

```html
<div class="progress-indicator progress-indicator--horizontal">
    <div class="progress-step progress-step--completed">
        <div class="progress-step__track">
            <div class="progress-step__circle" tabindex="0">
                <svg class="progress-step__check" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>
            </div>
            <div class="progress-step__connector"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-step__text">
            <span class="progress-step__name">Account Setup</span>
            <span class="progress-step__desc">Create your account</span>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="progress-step progress-step--current">
        <div class="progress-step__track">
            <div class="progress-step__circle" tabindex="0">
                <span class="progress-step__number">2</span>
            </div>
            <div class="progress-step__connector"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-step__text">
            <span class="progress-step__name">Personal Info</span>
            <span class="progress-step__desc">Fill in your details</span>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="progress-step progress-step--upcoming">
        <div class="progress-step__track">
            <div class="progress-step__circle" tabindex="0">
                <span class="progress-step__number">3</span>
            </div>
            <div class="progress-step__connector"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-step__text">
            <span class="progress-step__name">Verification</span>
            <span class="progress-step__desc">Verify your identity</span>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="progress-step progress-step--upcoming">
        <div class="progress-step__track">
            <div class="progress-step__circle" tabindex="0">
                <span class="progress-step__number">4</span>
            </div>
            <div class="progress-step__connector"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-step__text">
            <span class="progress-step__name">Confirmation</span>
            <span class="progress-step__desc">Review and confirm</span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```
